label: Phase 2 repair queries.py permission strings, LeaveBalance seeding, and Q filter
instruction: Fix the runtime bugs in modules/leave_elm/services/queries.py: (1) Import `Decimal` from `decimal`, `Q` from `django.db.models`, `PermissionDeniedError` from `core.api.exceptions`, `LEAVE_CATEGORY_NAMES, LEAVE_POLICY_DEFAULTS` from `modules.leave_elm.domain.policy`, and `LeaveApplication, LeaveBalance, LeaveCategory, LeaveNotification, LeaveTask, LeaveType` from `modules.leave_elm.models`. (2) Do NOT combine permission names with slashes! Check individual permissions separately: `has_admin_or_review = actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.record.manage')`. In `list_applications(actor, scope='mine')`: if not (`actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.view_self') or has_admin_or_review`), raise `PermissionDeniedError()`. If `scope == 'all'` and `has_admin_or_review`, return `LeaveApplication.objects.select_related('leave_type', 'leave_type__leave_category').order_by('-created_at', '-id')`; otherwise return `LeaveApplication.objects.select_related('leave_type', 'leave_type__leave_category').filter(user_id=actor.user_id).order_by('-created_at', '-id')`. (3) In `own_balances(actor)`: if not `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.view_self')`, raise `PermissionDeniedError()`. Loop `for cat_name in LEAVE_CATEGORY_NAMES:`: call `cat, _ = LeaveCategory.objects.get_or_create(name=cat_name, defaults={'description': cat_name})`, `LeaveType.objects.get_or_create(name=cat_name, defaults={'description': cat_name, 'leave_category': cat})`, and `LeaveBalance.objects.get_or_create(user_id=actor.user_id, leave_category=cat, defaults={'balance': Decimal(str(LEAVE_POLICY_DEFAULTS[cat_name]))})`. Return `LeaveBalance.objects.select_related('leave_category').filter(user_id=actor.user_id).order_by('leave_category__name', 'id')`. (4) In `assigned_tasks(actor)`: check `if not (actor.has_permission('leave_elm.task.view') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.substitute.respond') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')): raise PermissionDeniedError()`. Build `cond = Q(user_id=actor.user_id)`; if `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review')`: `cond = cond | Q(role='reviewer')`; if `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')`: `cond = cond | Q(role='authority')`; return `LeaveTask.objects.select_related('leave_application', 'leave_application__leave_type').filter(status='Pending').filter(cond).order_by('-created_at', '-id')`. (5) Keep `list_notifications(actor)`. Return only valid Python code.
